design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Retro arcade aesthetics mixed with sleek 2026 dark crypto terminal glassmorphism and high-voltage neon glow.
Emotion First: High-adrenaline degen energy — evoke excitement, trust, low-risk high-reward thrill, and community pride.
Content is King: Direct storytelling for 3 flagship games ($BUN, $CASHCAT, $FEFER) with live badges and instant CTA friction-free links.
Contrast & Motion: Deep obsidian dark canvas (#06070B, #0B0E17) punctuated by Electric Lime (#10B981), Cyber Purple (#A855F7), Neon Gold (#F59E0B), and Hot Magenta (#EC4899).

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow all instructions in this design_guidelines.json file strictly.
Implement the landing page with React and Tailwind CSS in /app/frontend/src/App.js or modular components.
Ensure 'Stake ARCADE' CTA button is prominently animated and links out to 'https://staking.memearcade'.
Ensure 'TRADE' button is dimmed, disabled, and non-interactive.

Render all 3 game exhibition cards with their respective titles, taglines, blurbs, memecoin tickers ($BUN, $CASHCAT, $FEFER), badges ('community Robinhood', 'community Stable'), LIVE status indicator, and clickable link out to their respective subdomains.
Integrate social links: X (x.com/myMemeArcade) and Telegram (t.me/memearcade).
Include data-testid attributes on all buttons, cards, links, and key sections as specified.
Use dark, glowing cyberpunk/degen theme (#06070C background) with smooth framer-motion animations.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid attribute in kebab-case for all buttons, links, inputs, and interactive cards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rule: Ensure all text has APCA high-contrast visibility against dark backgrounds. Never rely on transparent dropdowns or unreadable dark grey on black.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_center_app_rule: Do not center align the root .App container in CSS.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.hover_contrast_rule: Always explicitly define text color on hover states.
